page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Below it a table of years in three blocks separated by horizontal rules, with columns Ind., An.Iul., Lit.dom., Nabon., Feriæ., Christi. A bracket line in the Feriæ column marks festival dates across several rows. No text in the margins.

main_text.l: Ind. | An.Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | Christi,

page.notes: The Feriæ bracket lines are drawn dashes spanning rows; the festival dates (13 Aug., 12 Aug., 11 Aug., 10 Aug., 9 Aug., 8 Aug., 7 Aug., 6 Aug.) are written at the row where each bracket starts. The mark after 1515 is an italic figure or sign, read as 4 with doubt. Column headers are given as a table line. The "Christi," header ends with a comma as printed. Years are printed in a long-form numeral style; transcribed here as Arabic numerals. Some numerals in the Nabon. column are printed in an old, unclear form and are copied as best read.
